title: feat(nmmaxisy): incoming-axis agreement at t+1 on #7211: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Incoming-axis agreement on the #7211 y-probes: Axis(M)(A)=Axis(M)(B)={e_1}; Axis(M)(C)={e_2} vs Axis(M)(D)={e_2,e_3}. Face fails for one reason only -- D is the two-axis mixing site. Every band readout that requires a clean D fails on face and only on face.
